_about: War Department, The Adjutant General's Office, "World War II Honor List of Dead and Missing Army and Army Air Forces Personnel from Oklahoma, 1946", NARA NAID 305311, https://catalog.archives.gov/id/305311; the National Archives' page for it, with links to every page image: https://www.archives.gov/research/military/ww2/army-casualties/oklahoma.html. The PDF (33 pages, 21.8 MB, OCR text layer by Adobe Acrobat Paper Capture) is not committed: it is over GitHub's size limit, and it is re-obtainable from NARA. Where this copy was downloaded from was not recorded when it was fetched (Grok Bot, 2 or 3 October 2026); its sha256 identifies it. The text beside it is its OCR layer as pdftotext -layout reads it (3 October 2026): column order is unreliable, so read the page image for any entry relied on.
